scope: Offline implementation and synthetic regression validation; no empirical model-quality or release claim.

findings.title: Selected visual findings were absent from the edit request
changes: Exact approved findings and address/decline choices are bound to parent pixels, frozen brief, and canonical SHA-256 bundle.
API creates the bundle; worker reconstructs it from immutable scoped findings and rejects content/hash changes before authorization; actual image prompt contains the bundle.
Subsequent critics receive parent pixels, exact bundle, server-owned regression targets, and no same-round peer critiques.

findings.title: Funded study omitted production claim, objection and correction protocol
changes: Study freezes per-arm shared policy version/hash and shares proposal quorum, conditional revision, synthesis/audit routing, retry guards and correction predicate.
Every request carries scoped claims, material obligations, evidence assessments and repair diagnostics. Parallel rounds freeze the obligation snapshot at the barrier.
The pure discussion reducer is shared with live runtime; issue events and state are retained in the study journal. Audit true cannot erase unresolved material obligations.
A concrete failed audit or open material issue can admit at most one correction plus independent re-audit; original 24-call, two-call logical-role, time and currency ceilings remain.
Minor unclassified dissent remains visible but does not alone admit the optional revision round.
findings.scope_limit: The study remains explicitly fixed-evidence/preconfirmed-input with its journal executor; it does not reproduce live intake, research retrieval, or the full job-store engine. Human-curated evidence is not globally promoted to factual truth.

findings.title: Two critics could omit regression checks while appearing complete
changes: Pixel-delivery coverage, regression completeness, and unresolved blockers are separate fields. Every prior material/critical issue and locked requirement needs two explicit independent checks.
Missing, uncertain, declined, persistent and regressed checks remain unresolved; absent findings do not mean resolution.
Unresolved ancestor targets persist across V2/V3 even when critics supply only regression rows without repeating the issue as a new finding.

Legacy V2 critiques without regression checks can receive one append-only supplement per critic through the existing review action, using the original remaining inference allowance. Original critiques remain unchanged. Incomplete exhausted recovery stays explicitly limited.

findings.title: Renamed copies inflated independent task denominators
changes: Shared substantive case fingerprints remove display/identity aliases, normalize known unordered record collections, and preserve amounts, narrative, meaningful evidence, and ordered sequences.
Study, end-to-end release and visual manifests reject substantive duplicate fingerprints; optional development fingerprints reject renamed held-out overlap.
Release and visual fingerprint context includes decision-relevant requirements/evidence/rubrics. The tool does not infer semantic independence from a hash.

behavior: Same frozen tasks and planned primary denominator across arms; missing/failed/insufficiently reviewed results are not useful.
Paired wins/losses/ties and per-stratum summaries, recorded-seed cluster bootstrap intervals, exact McNemar only for independent task clusters.
Critical-defect differences withheld until both primary review sets are complete; exact one-sided zero-event bounds reported only under independent-case assumption.
Repeats remain diagnostics, not extra independent cases; original reviewer disagreement remains visible.
Approved reviewer roster enforced when supplied in frozen mapping; blinded output and measurement records bind exact retained trial/configuration identities.
Finite exact cost accounting includes unknown exposure; observed admitted latency denominator includes failed outcomes. No automatic phase/release pass.
limitations: Synthetic tests verify implementation, not task accuracy or human usefulness.
Distinct provider/reviewer identities do not themselves prove epistemic independence.
Small/unrepresentative clusters can give unreliable bootstrap precision; preregister thresholds and multiplicity handling.
Normalized hashes catch aliases, not paraphrases or shared hidden project dependencies.
No paid model runs or real human grading were performed.

checks: Actual mocked HTTP image prompt contains exact selected finding and declined choice.
Empty child critics cannot clear parent defect or locked requirement; disagreement remains persistent.
Append-only legacy recovery leaves originals unchanged; persistent ancestor survives next version.
Alias/title/order duplicate detected; altered cost and ordered sequence remain distinct.
Failed audit admits one bounded correction and independent re-audit, with no replay on rerun.
Claims receive stable distinct scoped IDs and are carried to synthesis.
Structured material objections trigger all revision nodes; unresolved obligations survive audit true; same-round critique contexts remain isolated.
Paired missing denominator and exact zero-event uncertainty verified.
Cost/latency records reject mismatched exposure and include failed admissions.
